Throughout the episode, Dr. Kumar discusses his experiences in various medical fields, including addiction medicine and occupational health, and how spirituality became a cornerstone of his practice. Discover how Dr. Kumar's educational journey, including a transformative course at Harvard University, reshaped his perspectives on medicine and patient care.

Explore the powerful concept of self-healing as Dr. Kumar highlights the significance of patient involvement in their healing journey. He shares insights about his upcoming holistic medical practice in New Jersey and his plans to revolutionize healthcare by bridging the gap between spirituality and medicine.

Tune in to this enlightening conversation that promises to inspire a deeper understanding of health, wellness, and the holistic path to healing.
